triage.note: S3-FONT (tasks/reviews/gates-2026-08-22.json, S3_browser_evidence.font_fallback_finding, MEDIUM, orchestrator-verified by measurement, not asserted): src/sec10k/web/static/index.html:10 is a render-blocking `<link rel=stylesheet>` to fonts.googleapis.com. On an origin that REFUSES the connection the page falls back to the ui-monospace stack (FCP 28ms); on an origin that BLACKHOLES it the page never painted inside an 8s budget and Playwright could not even capture the screenshot (tasks/reviews/s3-browser-walk.json, `fonts.blackholed`). The check asserts the PROPERTY, not a literal string: every live `<link>` with `stylesheet` in `rel` and an `href` on another host must carry a non-screen `media` type AND an `onload` that promotes it to all/screen; `<noscript>` blocks and HTML comments are stripped first (the no-JS fallback link is a plain blocking link by convention and by design — see the check's docstring for why that trade is accepted). Same-origin sheets and `@import` are out of scope and said so. The paired `ui-font-link-nonblocking-regression` pins that the check catches a second blocking link and a print-without-onload link, and does NOT fire on the noscript fallback, a same-origin sheet, or a commented-out link.

provenance: S3 follow-up PR, created 2026-08-22. Watched RED against origin/main d271547 (index.html:10 has no media/onload): runner line `[FAIL] ui-font-link-nonblocking (adversarial, 0.0s)`, invariant 43/44 = 0.977, fast 85/86 = 0.988; the failure string was `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2: external stylesheet is render-blocking (media='unset') — a blackholed host stops first paint; want media=print + an onload promoting it to all`. GREEN after `media="print" onload="this.media='all'"` plus the `<noscript>` fallback were added to that one link; nothing else in index.html changed.
